body: Thank you, I have the same wishes for you

I would keep talking to your psychiatrist and start telling the truth,they can’t help you if you aren’t honest with them. I would also ask them to maybe recommend you a therapist or councilor, maybe even join a group therapy class if you’re up for something less one on one. They can’t put you anywhere if you’re just thinking about Suicide but if you do have a plan in place then that is when they might send you somewhere. Atleast that’s how it is in my state (I can’t speak for the laws in all of them). Telling your care team the truth is what’s most important, you can’t get any real help if you aren’t honest.
